generality.selection: Library docs chosen by kind and available evidence, without fixed IDs, labels, counts or coordinates in selectors. Four real upload formats from different sources.

reserved_unseen.rule: Randomly selected before development; inspect/upload only in final test; path and size only seen.

fixed.behavior: Desktop library keeps selected file row and search beside document details.

remaining.issue: JPG ingest succeeds but first count answer has zero citations and no reasoning/confidence card.
Raster recount emits six scene highlight IDs absent from the scene; browser shows no glowing items. Answer says six while citation/evidence copy still describes four.
Production library hides all three tested picker selections. Local CSS fix needs merge and deployment.
Export report lists raw IFC GlobalIds. Replace with friendly labels while preserving numbered evidence.

artifacts: Screenshots, traces and response attachments remain under each run directory in this worktree. Large binary traces stay untracked per repository size rules.
